events.title: Reson8 opens a 0.5B multilingual ASR model built for throughput
events.title_zh: Reson8 开源面向高吞吐的 0.5B 多语种 ASR 模型
events.summary: Reson8 released Rumble 2 Flash, a 0.5-billion-parameter automatic speech recognition model for more than 40 languages. Apache-2.0 weights run through native Transformers and vLLM without custom code. The publisher reports 7,000 times real-time throughput on full batches and 6.96% error on Open ASR multilingual evaluation.
events.summary_en: Reson8 released Rumble 2 Flash, a 0.5-billion-parameter automatic speech recognition model for more than 40 languages. Apache-2.0 weights run through native Transformers and vLLM without custom code. The publisher reports 7,000 times real-time throughput on full batches and 6.96% error on Open ASR multilingual evaluation.
events.summary_zh: Reson8 发布 Rumble 2 Flash：一个支持 40 多种语言的 5 亿参数自动语音识别模型。Apache-2.0 权重可直接通过 Transformers 与 vLLM 运行，无需自定义代码。发布方称满 batch 吞吐达 7,000 倍实时速度，Open ASR 多语评测错误率为 6.96%。
events.why_it_matters: Teams processing large audio backlogs can test a small, permissively licensed model without a custom runtime. Speed and quality results are publisher-reported, so domain accents, noisy calls and tail latency still need local measurement.
events.why_it_matters_en: Teams processing large audio backlogs can test a small, permissively licensed model without a custom runtime. Speed and quality results are publisher-reported, so domain accents, noisy calls and tail latency still need local measurement.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 处理大量音频积压的团队可以用宽松许可的小模型试验，不必维护自定义 runtime。速度与质量仍是发布方自报，领域口音、嘈杂通话和尾延迟需要本地测量。

technical_details.runtime: Transformers and vLLM without custom code
technical_details.publisher_quality: 6.96% Open ASR multilingual error; 6.6% English WER; 7.86% WER on 302 hours of AppTek call-center data versus 7.78% for Nemotron 3.5
technical_details.evidence_limit: Publisher-reported; no independent reproduction in this run
technical_details.time_precision: Official post exposed 2026-11-18 without a publication time

technical_details_zh.运行方式: 原生 Transformers 与 vLLM，无需自定义代码
technical_details_zh.发布方质量: Open ASR 多语错误率 6.96%；英语 WER 6.6%；AppTek 302 小时呼叫中心数据 WER 7.86%，Nemotron 3.5 为 7.78%
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 数据来自发布方，本次未独立复现
technical_details_zh.时间精度: 官方文章只给出 2026-11-18，没有发布时间

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用 2 小时真实多语音频比较 WER、RTFx、P95 延迟、显存和领域词漏识别。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, test two hours of real multilingual audio for WER, RTFx, P95 latency, memory and missed domain terms.

evidence.claim_zh: Rumble 2 Flash 已公开 Apache-2.0 权重，并原生支持 Transformers 与 vLLM。
evidence.claim_en: Rumble 2 Flash has public Apache-2.0 weights with native Transformers and vLLM support.

changes.summary_zh: Rumble 2 Flash 公开权重与原生推理支持
changes.summary_en: Rumble 2 Flash opens its weights and native inference support

events.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon across its API and coding tools
events.title_zh: Google 在 API 与编程工具中推出 Gemini 4 Neon
events.summary_en: Google released Gemini 4 Neon in the Gemini API paid tier and AI Studio, with a 1M-token context window. GitHub Copilot also made it generally available across paid plans, while Google app access depends on Pro or Ultra subscriptions. The model is closed and its benchmark claims remain vendor-selected.
events.summary_zh: Google 已在 Gemini API 付费层和 AI Studio 推出 Gemini 4 Neon，上下文窗口为 100 万 token。GitHub Copilot 也向付费方案开放，Google 应用侧则取决于 Pro 或 Ultra 订阅。模型不开源，性能数字仍主要来自厂商选取的评测。
events.why_it_matters_en: For coding-agent teams, this changes the available price, context and integration choices now rather than announcing a future model. Repository-level testing is still needed before replacing an incumbent.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 coding agent 团队来说，这次变化已落到价格、上下文和现成集成，不是预告。是否替换现有模型，仍要用真实仓库复测。

technical_details.availability: Gemini API paid tier, AI Studio, Gemini for Business, Antigravity Pro/Ultra, and paid GitHub Copilot plans
technical_details.pricing: $3 per million input tokens, $0.15 cached input, $15 output
technical_details.evidence_limit: Benchmark results are vendor-selected; independent leaderboard data does not establish workload fit

technical_details_zh.可用性: Gemini API 付费层、AI Studio、Gemini for Business、Antigravity Pro/Ultra 与 GitHub Copilot 付费方案
technical_details_zh.价格: 每百万 input token 3 美元，cached input 0.15 美元，output 15 美元
technical_details_zh.证据限制: benchmark 由厂商选取；独立榜单也不能代替真实工作负载验证

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用同一组真实仓库任务对比现用模型，记录成功率、延迟、缓存命中和总成本。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, compare it with the incumbent on the same repository tasks and record success, latency, cache hits and total cost.

evidence.claim_zh: Google 与 GitHub 的公告确认模型、价格、上下文和当前可用范围。
evidence.claim_en: Google and GitHub announcements confirm the model, pricing, context and current access.

changes.summary_zh: Gemini 4 Neon 进入 API、AI Studio 与 GitHub Copilot
changes.summary_en: Gemini 4 Neon reaches the API, AI Studio and GitHub Copilot

events.title: RadixArk opens DaisyRose-27B for long-horizon coding agents
events.title_zh: RadixArk 开放面向长任务编程 agent 的 DaisyRose-27B
events.summary_en: RadixArk released DaisyRose-27B with Apache-2.0 BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 weights plus public SGLang serving instructions. It was trained from Qwen3.8-27B on 1,200 curated long-horizon tasks. Reported benchmark gains are publisher-run, and the public training stack is not the same as the internal backend.
events.summary_zh: RadixArk 发布 DaisyRose-27B，提供 Apache-2.0 的 BF16、FP8 和 NVFP4 权重，以及公开 SGLang 部署说明。模型基于 Qwen3.8-27B，用 1,200 个长任务训练。benchmark 提升由发布方测得，公开训练栈也不等同于内部后端。
events.why_it_matters_en: Local coding-agent teams can test a reproducible 27B-class checkpoint instead of relying on an API. The serving path is available, but the claimed long-horizon gains need independent reproduction.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 本地 coding agent 团队现在可以直接测试 27B 级权重，而不必依赖 API。部署路径已公开，但长任务收益仍需要独立复现。

technical_details.artifacts: BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 weights with SGLang instructions
technical_details.training: 1,200 curated long-horizon tasks; publisher reports 144 H200 GPUs
technical_details.evidence_limit: Benchmark gains are publisher-run and the internal backend differs from the public trainer

technical_details_zh.产物: BF16、FP8、NVFP4 权重与 SGLang 部署说明
technical_details_zh.训练: 1,200 个长任务；发布方称使用 144 张 H200
technical_details_zh.证据限制: benchmark 由发布方运行，内部后端与公开 trainer 不同

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开权重跑三项真实长任务，比较完成率、显存、延迟和恢复能力。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, run three real long-horizon tasks with the public weights and compare completion, memory, latency and recovery.

evidence.claim_zh: 官方技术报告确认权重、许可、训练范围和公开部署路径。
evidence.claim_en: The official technical report confirms weights, license, training scope and public serving path.

changes.summary_zh: DaisyRose-27B 开放权重与部署说明
changes.summary_en: DaisyRose-27B opens weights and serving instructions

events.title: Anthropic begins Nasdaq trading after its record IPO
events.title_zh: Anthropic 完成首日 Nasdaq 交易
events.summary_en: Anthropic shares began trading under ANT on November 19 after the company priced 980 million shares at $83. Associated Press reported the first day ended at a market value of roughly $1.75 trillion. Trading is now observed, while closing and the final use of proceeds remain separate questions.
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 在以每股 83 美元为 9.8 亿股定价后，于 11 月 19 日以 ANT 开始交易。Associated Press 报道首日结束时市值约 1.75 万亿美元。交易已发生；交割和最终资金用途仍需分别核实。
events.why_it_matters_en: The first trading day turns pricing expectations into a public market signal for frontier-model capital. It still does not establish model quality or show that all stated proceeds have closed and been deployed.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 首日交易把定价预期变成了前沿模型资本的公开市场信号。它仍不能证明模型质量，也不代表所述资金已全部交割或投入使用。

technical_details.public_offering: 980 million shares at $83; $81.34 billion gross offering value
technical_details.evidence_limit: Trading is reported by AP; closing and deployment of proceeds remain separately unverified

technical_details_zh.公开发行: 9.8 亿股，每股 83 美元；发行总值 813.4 亿美元
technical_details_zh.证据限制: AP 报道确认交易；交割与资金投入仍需单独核实
technical_details_zh.报道的收盘市值: 约 1.75 万亿美元，来源 Associated Press

events.next_action_zh: 等待交割与后续披露，再判断资金是否改变算力、价格或开发者产品路线。
events.next_action_en: Wait for closing and subsequent disclosures before judging effects on compute, pricing or developer products.

evidence.claim_zh: 公司公告与 SEC 文件确认发行定价和预期交易、交割条件。
evidence.claim_en: The company announcement and SEC filing confirm pricing and the expected trading and closing conditions.

evidence.claim_zh: Associated Press 报道确认 ANT 已开始交易，并给出首日结束时的市场估值。
evidence.claim_en: Associated Press reporting confirms ANT began trading and reports its end-of-day market value.

events.title: Architect Labs reports an AI-designed pre-silicon CPU architecture
events.title_zh: Architect Labs 报告 AI 设计的预硅 CPU 架构
events.summary: Architect Labs reported Frostbite, a general-purpose CPU architecture built around interaction nets and co-designed by agent swarms across compiler, ISA, RTL and verification. On 25 publisher-selected workloads, including 15 held out until final evaluation, the pre-silicon design averaged 4.59 times the performance per watt of a modern dual-issue in-order core. The result is based on models, synthesis and final GDS, not fabricated silicon.
events.summary_en: Architect Labs reported Frostbite, a general-purpose CPU architecture built around interaction nets and co-designed by agent swarms across compiler, ISA, RTL and verification. On 25 publisher-selected workloads, including 15 held out until final evaluation, the pre-silicon design averaged 4.59 times the performance per watt of a modern dual-issue in-order core. The result is based on models, synthesis and final GDS, not fabricated silicon.
events.summary_zh: Architect Labs 报告 Frostbite：一种基于 interaction net 的通用 CPU 架构，由 agent swarm 跨 compiler、ISA、RTL 与验证共同设计。在 25 个发布方选定的 workload 上，包含最终评测前保留的 15 个任务，预硅设计平均每瓦性能为现代双发射顺序执行核心的 4.59 倍。结果来自模型、综合和最终 GDS，不是流片实测。
events.why_it_matters: The project is unusually complete for an AI-designed hardware claim, reaching formal contracts and final layout. Hardware teams should still treat it as pre-silicon research until artifacts, independent reproduction and fabricated-chip measurements are available.
events.why_it_matters_en: The project is unusually complete for an AI-designed hardware claim, reaching formal contracts and final layout. Hardware teams should still treat it as pre-silicon research until artifacts, independent reproduction and fabricated-chip measurements are available.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 这项 AI 设计硬件的工作完整度较高，做到形式化 contract 与最终版图。硬件团队仍应把它视为预硅研究，等待公开产物、独立复现和流片测量。

technical_details.architecture: Interaction-net CPU with a new ISA and Vine/Ivy software stack
technical_details.process: 7 nm; 800 MHz synthesis and 500 MHz final GDS
technical_details.evaluation: 25 workloads; 10 search and 15 held out until final evaluation
technical_details.publisher_result: 4.59x average performance per watt versus a dual-issue in-order comparison core
technical_details.verification: ASL machine-checkable specification lowered to more than 800,000 lines of Lean; RTL and GDS flow
technical_details.evidence_limit: Pre-silicon publisher result; no fabricated chip, public artifact set or independent reproduction established
technical_details.time_basis: Official post dated 2026-11-18 with date precision only; recovered by recall audit outside overlap

technical_details_zh.架构: 基于 interaction net 的 CPU，配套新 ISA 与 Vine/Ivy 软件栈
technical_details_zh.工艺: 7 nm；综合达到 800 MHz，最终 GDS 为 500 MHz
technical_details_zh.评测: 25 个 workload；10 个用于搜索，15 个保留到最终评测
technical_details_zh.发布方结果: 对比双发射顺序执行核心，平均每瓦性能为 4.59 倍
technical_details_zh.验证: ASL 机器可检查规范下沉为 80 多万行 Lean；完成 RTL 与 GDS 流程
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 发布方预硅结果；没有流片芯片、完整公开产物或独立复现
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 官方文章日期为 2026-11-18，只有日期精度；本轮由召回审计在 overlap 外补录

events.next_action_zh: 等待公开 RTL、独立综合复现和流片测量后，再评估其架构与 agent 设计流程。
events.next_action_en: Wait for public RTL, independent synthesis reproduction and fabricated-silicon measurements before evaluating the architecture or agent workflow.

evidence.claim_zh: 官方技术文章确认架构、held-out workload、形式化流程与预硅结果。
evidence.claim_en: The official technical article confirms the architecture, held-out workloads, formal flow and pre-silicon results.

changes.summary_zh: Frostbite 完成从架构探索到 GDS 的 AI 设计流程
changes.summary_en: Frostbite completes an AI design flow from architecture search to GDS
